note: Quantities are planning baselines for one adult. Adjust for children, elderly, pregnancy, pets, climate and medication needs. Inspect and rotate consumables every 6 months.

kits.name: Everyday Carry (EDC)
kits.description: Minimum capability carried on the body.

items.text: Primary flashlight + spare battery
Folding knife or multitool
Two independent fire starters (lighter + ferro rod)
Water bottle and purification tablets
Tourniquet, gauze, tape, gloves
10 m paracord
Compass and local paper map
Charged phone + power bank; programmed handheld radio if licensed
Cash in small bills
ID, emergency contacts, medical card
Pealess whistle
Space blanket / emergency bivy

kits.name: 72-Hour Go Bag
kits.description: Grab-and-go kit for three days away from home.

items.text: Water: 12 L per person (3 days minimum)
Water filter + purification tablets + metal cup
3 days no-cook food (2,000 kcal/day) + manual can opener
Comprehensive first-aid kit + personal prescriptions (7 days)
AM/FM/NOAA radio + spare batteries or hand crank
Headlamp + spare batteries
Tent/tarp, cordage, sleeping bag or blanket, ground pad
Full change of clothing, rain shell, insulation, sturdy boots
Lighter, ferro rod, waterproof tinder
Multitool, duct tape, zip ties, repair kit
Soap, toothbrush, menstrual products, toilet paper, hand sanitizer
Waste bags, trowel, disinfectant
Copies of ID, insurance, medications, contacts; USB backup
Cash, including small denominations
N95/P100 masks and eye protection
Whistle, signal mirror, high-visibility marker
Local map, compass, pencil, route card
Pet food, leash, carrier, vaccination record

kits.name: INCH / Long-Duration Bag
kits.description: I'm Never Coming Home: sustainment and rebuilding tools.

items.text: Water storage: 20+ L + 2 filters + spare parts
14+ days food + seeds + fishing/hunting kit where legal
Four-season shelter, stove, fuel, sleep system
Axe, saw, shovel, pry bar, files, sharpening stones
Sewing kit, wire, hose clamps, glue, spare buckles, batteries
Trauma kit, antibiotics if prescribed, 30-day medication supply
HF/VHF radio, antenna wire, power supply, written comms plan
Solar panel, charge controller, battery bank, cables
Paper maps, field manuals, ID copies, offline data drive
Trade goods: salt, lighters, batteries, coffee, sewing kits
Cache plan with GPS/MGRS coordinates, contents list, access notes

kits.name: Vehicle Kit
kits.description: Keep in the vehicle year-round; rotate water and food.

items.text: 12 L water + cup + filter
2 days shelf-stable food
First-aid kit + trauma kit + gloves
Jack, lug wrench, tire plug kit, compressor, jumper cables/pack
Full tank + 20 L approved fuel container
Blankets, gloves, hat, rain gear, boots
Warning triangle, reflective vest, whistle, headlamp
ABC fire extinguisher
Paper maps, compass, route notes
Charger, power bank, radio, written contacts
Tow strap, traction boards, shovel, sand/salt (winter)
Registration, insurance, emergency contacts
Water: 4 L/person/day x 14 days (56 L/person)
Food-grade containers, rotated every 6 months
14 days food + manual can opener + cooking fuel
Camp stove/fuel or BBQ with fuel; never indoors
LED lanterns, headlamps, candles, matches, batteries
Safe backup heat, CO alarm, fire extinguisher
30-day medication supply, first aid, glasses, dental kit
Bucket toilet, bags, lime/kitty litter, soap, disinfectant
NOAA radio, AM/FM radio, charged power banks
Generator or battery/solar backup + fuel
Waterproof copies of IDs, deeds, insurance, medical records
Locks, lighting, extinguishers, plan with neighbours
Cash reserve in small bills
Confirm outage extent with neighbours and radio
Keep fridge/freezer closed; 4 h fridge / 48 h full freezer
Fill bathtub and containers before pressure is lost
Start backup power only outdoors/ventilated; never backfeed
Monitor NOAA/emergency broadcasts; conserve phone battery
Use battery lights, not candles, near sleeping areas
Check medication refrigeration and oxygen needs
Withdraw cash early; card systems may fail
Lock doors, share status with trusted neighbours, avoid generators indoors
Set water/power conservation and evacuation trigger points

kits.name: Winter / Cold Snap
kits.description: Prevent hypothermia, pipe damage and vehicle stranding.

items.text: Safe heat plan, CO alarm, dry firewood/fuel
Drip faucets, insulate/heat-trace pipes, know shutoff
Layers, dry socks, gloves, hats, boots
Seal one room as a warming area; keep vents clear
Store water before freezing; melt snow only with fuel
Winter kit, full tank, blanket, shovel, sand, phone charger
Bring animals inside; protect water from freezing
Check on elderly/isolated neighbours

kits.name: Wildfire
kits.description: Leave early; do not defend an indefensible home.

items.text: Sign up for local alerts; monitor radio and lookouts
Go bag, N95 masks, goggles, water, documents, medications
Two evacuation routes; know wind direction and road closures
Clear defensible space, remove fuel from gutters/porch, close vents
Park facing out, windows up, fuel full, keys ready
Tell someone your destination and ETA
If trapped, shelter in a cleared area; call emergency services

kits.name: Flood
kits.description: Water is the hazard; move to high ground early.

items.text: Monitor alerts; know river gauge and evacuation zone
Go bag, water, meds, documents, phone power, cash
Never drive through moving water; 30 cm can float a vehicle
Move electrical items up; shut off power only if safe and dry
Assume floodwater is contaminated; boil/filter all drinking water
Hand hygiene, gloves, boots, tetanus status
Document damage; avoid downed lines and weakened structures

kits.name: Earthquake
kits.description: Drop, cover, hold on; then expect aftershocks.

items.text: Drop, cover, hold on; stay away from glass and heavy objects
Know how to shut off gas; only if you smell or hear a leak
Go bag, sturdy shoes, gloves, flashlight, dust mask
Do not drink from damaged pipes; use stored water
Text rather than call; expect network congestion
Expect aftershocks; inspect structure before re-entry
If near coast, move inland/high ground immediately after shaking

kits.name: Radiological / Nuclear
kits.description: Get inside, stay inside, stay tuned. Sheltering is the priority.

items.text: Get inside the nearest building; basement or centre of a multi-storey building
Close windows/doors, shut off HVAC, seal gaps with tape/plastic if available
Use battery radio/NOAA; follow official instructions
KI only when directed by authorities; age-specific dose
Use sealed stored water/food; avoid open water and fresh produce
Remove outer clothing, bag it, shower with soap and water
Record dose rate and time; minimise time, maximise distance/shielding
Evacuate only when told; know routes and reception centres

kits.name: Pandemic / Biological
kits.description: Reduce contacts, protect airways, support the sick safely.

items.text: N95/KN95 masks, gloves, eye protection, hand sanitizer
Isolation room, separate bathroom if possible, ventilation
Fever/pain relief, ORS, thermometer, pulse oximeter
14 days water and food; minimise shopping trips
Handwashing, surface disinfection, laundry protocol
Care plan for dependants, pets, medications and work
Official public-health sources only; write down key numbers

kits.name: Bug-Out / Evacuation
kits.description: Decision and execution checklist. Leave early if you can.

items.text: Define written evacuation triggers (not gut feeling alone)
Primary and alternate rally points; accountable person list
Two routes, fuel plan, choke points, paper map
Comms plan, check-in times, radio frequencies, phone tree
Load vehicle in priority order; secure loose items
Shut off utilities if instructed; lock up; leave note
Cache coordinates and contents documented offline
Report arrival, establish security and water first
